title: Ijwi ryo Gukomera
intro: Uyu muntu yibukwa kubera ubwenge n'ubuyobozi bwimbitse, atanga inama zirenze ibisekuruza. Amagambo ye ni igihamya cy'ubuyoboke n'akamaro ko kumenya imigisha n'ibigeragezo biva ku Mana. Hindura uwo ari we wese muri twe yubahwa.
clues: Ntabwo nari umuhanuzi, ariko ubwenge bwanjye buhora butangwa mu Byanditswe Byera.
Inama nagiriye umwana wanjye yashimangiye gushimira Imana no kwirinda shirk.
Nigishije akamaro ko gusenga, gutegeka icyiza, no kubuza ikibi.
Naburiye kwirinda ubwibone no kugendana n'ubwibone ku isi.
Izina ryanjye ryahawe igice cyose muri Korowani, rigaragaza inyigisho zanjye.
Inama natanze zari zirimo kwihangana mu bihe bigoye, kuko mu by’ukuri, ibyo biva mu bintu bikomeye kurusha ibindi.

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yayoboye ubwoko bwe mu gihugu gishya

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
